findings.title: Duplicated KPI card wrapper markup
findings.description: Each of the six KPI cards repeats the exact same Link + Card structure and hover classes (`transition-all hover:border-primary/30 hover:shadow-md`). A small `KPICard` helper would make future additions or styling changes a single-point edit and reduce visual noise.
findings.fix_suggestion: Extract a local `KPICard` component that accepts `href`, `title`, `icon`, `children`, and optional top-border props, then render the six cards through it.

findings.title: Repeated overdue-amount conditional inside one card
findings.description: The expression `(analyticsOverview?.overdueAmount ?? 0) > 0` is evaluated four separate times within the Overdue Amount card to choose border color, dot color, text color, and helper text. This duplication is a concrete mismatch risk if the threshold or fallback ever changes.
findings.fix_suggestion: Compute `const hasOverdue = (analyticsOverview?.overdueAmount ?? 0) > 0;` once and reuse it for the four conditional class names/messages.

findings.title: Optional EmptyState action prop is never omitted
findings.description: `EmptyState` declares `action` as optional, but all six current call sites supply it, so the optional branch is dead code in practice. Making it required (or documenting a future use case) would make the type contract clearer and remove the unused code path.
findings.location: apps/web/src/app/(dashboard)/page.tsx — EmptyState helper and its six call sites
findings.fix_suggestion: Change `action` to required in EmptyState props, or keep it optional only if a call site without a CTA is planned.

findings.title: Composite isLoading flag omits several rendered queries
findings.description: `isLoading` guards the skeleton with only `overviewLoading || revenueLoading || salesLoading || forecastLoading`, but the rendered JSX also depends on `comparisonData`, `analyticsOverview`, `agingData`, and `topProductsData`. This pattern makes it easy for a future query addition to render the dashboard with partial or zero data while other requests are still in flight.
findings.fix_suggestion: Derive `isLoading` from all relevant loading flags (`overviewLoading || revenueLoading || salesLoading || forecastLoading || agingLoading || productsLoading || comparisonLoading`), or switch to a single dashboard query that returns the whole view model.

residual_risks: Revenue by Month chart has no empty state, while the Pipeline chart and all table sections do. The inconsistency may confuse users when no revenue data exists.

The dashboard page is ~650 lines and mixes data fetching, derived state, and UI. Continued polish is likely to bloat it further; consider splitting into `DashboardKpiCards`, `DashboardCharts`, and `DashboardTables` sections when the next feature touches this file.
Activity list items always link to `/activities` regardless of activity type. If per-type deep links are added later, the `ACTIVITY_ICONS` mapping will need to expand to include both icon and route.
testing_gaps: No tests verify that each KPI card links to the expected route (`/deals`, `/invoices`, etc.).
No tests assert `EmptyState` renders the provided CTA button with the correct href.
No tests verify the skeleton is shown until all dependent dashboard queries have resolved, which is important given the composite `isLoading` logic.
